create_Gemma4VideoProcessor: create a Gemma4VideoProcessor instance with patch_size, max_soft_tokens, and pooling_kernel_size parameters
convert_video_to_patches: convert a 4D video tensor of shape (num_frames, num_channels, height, width) into 3D patches of shape (num_frames, num_patches, patch_pixels)
pad_to_max_patches: pad a video tensor and its position ids to a target maximum number of patches with zero and -1 fill values
resize_video_aspect_preserving: resize a video tensor to an aspect ratio preserving size based on patch_size, max_patches, and pooling_kernel_size
preprocess_videos_gemma4: preprocess a list of video tensors into pixel_values_videos, video_position_ids, and num_soft_tokens_per_video for Gemma4 model input
